subject.title: [Feature]: Inbound media shared across all agents — no per-agent isolation

question: What scoped inbound-media isolation contract should OpenClaw support across the core media store, plugin SDK media saves, managed media refs, and sandbox staging?
rationale: The code can technically write nested media subdirs, but choosing the permanent scope, URI shape, compatibility behavior, and fallback policy changes the security boundary for multi-agent deployments and plugin authors.

options.title: Define a generic scoped media contract
options.body: Use a core/plugin SDK contract for scoped inbound media, update bundled channels and sandbox staging together, and document the upgrade behavior for existing flat files.

options.title: Keep this as per-channel follow-ups
options.body: Handle Feishu or Discord-specific isolation first, accepting that the broad shared-store privacy gap remains until a later core contract is chosen.

options.title: Keep the flat store and document limits
options.body: Treat the shared inbound store as expected behavior and document that operators must isolate media access through workspaces or deployment boundaries.

recommendation.title: Define a generic scoped media contract
recommendation.body: Use a core/plugin SDK contract for scoped inbound media, update bundled channels and sandbox staging together, and document the upgrade behavior for existing flat files.
